lists.AI Context Optimization: Tools and techniques for optimizing AI context, such as prompt/context compression, pruning, caching, and window management. Most confused with Agent Memory and RAG/GraphRAG, which handle memory storage and retrieval pipelines; general automation, model routing, and databases do not belong.
lists.AI Design Tools: Repositories for AI-powered design tools belong here, especially those generating or editing visual/UI designs with AI models. Do not include general UI Design Tools, Automation (AI Powered), Business Tools (AI), or Frameworks/libraries unless the repo's core purpose is AI design.
lists.Agent Harness: Agent harnesses are orchestration layers that run an LLM agent loop, invoking tools and managing state, sandboxing, and evaluation. Most confused with Agent Tool-call, Agent Skills, Frameworks/libraries, and Automation (AI Powered); exclude raw tool adapters, memory stores, skill packs, model routers, general workflow automation, or UI.
lists.Agent Memory: Repositories for persistent, long-term memory in AI agents—storage, recall, and memory management across sessions. Likely confused with RAG/GraphRAG, AI Context Optimization, and Agent Harness; exclude general retrieval pipelines, context-window compression, and agent orchestration frameworks.
lists.Agent Skills: Repositories that provide reusable capabilities, skills, or instructions for AI agents, such as skill libraries or packages, belong here. Not Agent Harness, Agent Tool-call, or Agent Memory, which cover orchestration, tool invocation plumbing, and memory respectively.
lists.Agent Tool-call: Repositories about agents calling tools belong here. Likely confused with Agent Harness, Agent Skills, Agent Memory, and Automation (AI Powered); those cover orchestration, reusable skills, memory, or general automation, not the tool-call layer itself.
lists.Automation (AI Powered): Repositories for AI-powered automation tools that use LLMs or agents to execute workflows, tasks, or business processes belong here. Most likely confused with Automation (Non-ai first), Agent Harness, Agent Skills, and Business Tools (AI); non-AI scripts, workflow engines without AI, and generic agent frameworks do not belong.
lists.Automation (Non-ai first): For general-purpose, non-AI-first automation tools and scripts; AI-centric automation belongs in Automation (AI Powered), while agent orchestration or tool-call systems go to Agent Harness or Agent Tool-call. Database tools, frameworks/libraries, and business tools are separate unless the repo's primary purpose is automation itself.
lists.Awesome Lists: Repositories that are themselves curated awesome-style collections of links and resources belong here, not individual tools, libraries, or topic projects. Often confused with Frameworks/libraries, Business Tools (Non-AI), or Local LLM tools, which cover actual software rather than meta link lists.
lists.Backend Scaling: This List covers repositories focused on scaling backend infrastructure, such as load balancing, caching, sharding, and distributed resource orchestration. It is not Frameworks/libraries, Database tools, SQLite, or Inference Engines, which concern application code, databases, or model serving, not backend capacity scaling.
lists.Business Tools (AI): AI-powered tools for business operations and management belong here. Most likely confused with Business Tools (Non-AI), Automation (AI Powered), and AI Design Tools, which cover non-AI business software, general automation, or design work respectively.
lists.Business Tools (Non-AI): Non-AI software tools for business operations. Not to be confused with Business Tools (AI) or Automation (Non-ai first); AI business tools and general automation do not belong.
lists.Database tools: Database tools contains utilities for administering, querying, or migrating databases, distinct from the SQLite-specific List. It should not be confused with RAG/GraphRAG, Backend Scaling, or general Frameworks/libraries.
lists.Frameworks/libraries: Software frameworks and libraries: reusable code packages that structure or extend application development, excluding standalone programming languages, UI-specific frameworks, and backend scaling tools covered by sibling Lists. Most likely confused with UI Frameworks and Programming Languages; empty evidence means only the title suggests this general software scope.
lists.Inference Engines: Repositories for model inference execution and serving runtimes belong here. Not LLM Models, Local LLM tools, LLM Model Routing, Frameworks/libraries, or Backend Scaling, which cover weights, local interfaces, routing, general libraries, and scaling instead.
lists.Jev Model Alternatives: Repositories proposing alternatives to Jev models, including replacement model implementations or variant approaches, belong here. Distinguish from Typesafe-Jev, which covers type-safe Jev tooling, and from LLM Models, Small Language Models, and Local LLM tools, which are general model lists rather than Jev-specific alternatives.
lists.LLM Model Routing: Repositories for routing prompts or requests across multiple LLM models/providers, including selection, fallback, and cost/latency-based dispatch. Not LLM Models (model catalogs/weights) or Inference Engines (serving runtimes); distinguish from AI Context Optimization and Agent Tool-call.
lists.LLM Models: Pretrained foundation model repositories, weights, model cards, and model families belong here. Distinguish from Inference Engines, Local LLM tools, and LLM Model Routing; runtimes, serving, routing, and agent frameworks do not belong.
lists.Local LLM tools: Tools for running, managing, or interacting with LLMs locally on user hardware, such as local chat clients, model managers, and desktop runners. Most confused with Inference Engines, LLM Models, and LLM Model Routing; exclude model weights, cloud-only API services, and generic agent frameworks.
lists.Other: This List is the catch-all for repositories that do not fit any sibling List; it is currently empty. Do not confuse it with Awesome Lists, Frameworks/libraries, or Programming Languages, since anything matching those or other named siblings belongs there, not here.
lists.Programming Languages: Repositories primarily about programming languages themselves belong here. Most likely confused with Frameworks/libraries and Typesafe-Jev; frameworks, libraries, databases, AI agents, and other tooling do not belong.
lists.RAG/GraphRAG: RAG/GraphRAG covers retrieval-augmented generation systems and graph-based retrieval pipelines, including chunking, indexing, retrieval, and graph construction. It is distinct from Agent Memory and AI Context Optimization, and excludes Database tools, Frameworks/libraries, Inference Engines, and LLM Model Routing.
lists.SQLite: Repositories focused specifically on SQLite: its engine, bindings, extensions, and SQLite-only tooling. Most likely confused with Database tools, Frameworks/libraries, and Agent Memory; general database utilities, non-SQLite libraries, and abstract agent-memory systems do not belong.
lists.Small Language Models: Small Language Models covers repositories focused on compact, lightweight language models, including SLM releases, fine-tunes, and tooling specifically for them. It is distinct from LLM Models (general large models) and Local LLM tools (runners/hardware); it excludes inference engines, agent frameworks, and general LLM infrastructure unless centered on SLMs.
lists.Typesafe-Jev: Repositories implementing or extending TypeSafe Jev, especially TypeScript code that recursively selects from taxonomies while working around Jev's 255-option choice cap. This is not general Programming Languages or Frameworks/libraries material, nor taxonomies or classification tools unrelated to TypeSafe Jev.
lists.UI Design Tools: UI design tools belong here: software for visually designing, prototyping, wireframing, or editing user interfaces. Most confused with UI Frameworks and AI Design Tools; UI Frameworks (code libraries) and AI Design Tools (AI-generated design) do not belong.
lists.UI Frameworks: UI Frameworks covers libraries and toolkits for building user interfaces, such as component, rendering, or styling frameworks; the List is currently empty. It should not be confused with UI Design Tools, AI Design Tools, or Frameworks/libraries, which cover design assets, AI-assisted design, or non-UI software libraries.
lists.Wordpress: Repositories for WordPress core, plugins, themes, and WordPress-specific tooling belong here. Don't confuse this with Frameworks/libraries, Database tools, or Automation (Non-ai first): general PHP frameworks, standalone databases, and non-WordPress automation do not belong.
